faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about studying in Turkey

items.q: How much does it cost to study in Turkey?
items.a: Tuition fees in Turkey range from $3,000 to $15,000 per year depending on the university and program. Public universities are generally more affordable, while private universities may offer scholarships to reduce costs.

items.q: Can I study in English in Turkey?
items.a: Yes! Many top Turkish universities offer full English-medium programs, including Boğaziçi, METU, Koç, Sabancı, and Bilkent universities. Our consultants can help you find the right English-taught program.

items.q: What scholarships are available for international students?
items.a: Turkey offers excellent scholarships including the government-funded Türkiye Bursları (covers tuition + accommodation + stipend), and university-specific scholarships ranging from 25% to 100% tuition discounts.

items.q: How long does the application process take?
items.a: The application process typically takes 4-8 weeks. With Yildiz Foundation's guidance, we streamline the process and help you prepare all necessary documents efficiently.

items.q: Do I need to learn Turkish to study in Turkey?
items.a: Not necessarily. If you choose an English-medium program, you can study without knowing Turkish. However, learning basic Turkish will greatly enhance your daily life experience.

items.q: What is the student visa process for Turkey?
items.a: Once you receive your acceptance letter, you apply for a student visa at your nearest Turkish consulate. The process usually takes 2-4 weeks. Our team provides full support throughout the visa application.
